issue: U34: Main-menu Load/Continue exposes the game HUD before showing the loading picture.
finding: Main.start_game creates the HUD before Session.load_game_shown. That method previously awaited simulation-service startup before any LoadingScreen.prepare. An actual main-menu/worker baseline presents 42 uncovered HUD frames.
changes: Prepare and hold the loading picture before starting or requesting the local simulation service. SaveInfo selects the progress movie; saves lacking that header get the generic native progress movie.
Keep the picture through the existing host load barrier and close it on startup cancellation or failed load.
